summary: San Francisco Bay Area, web developer, pro-bono work for Africa Nutrition Society, strong interest in open-source software and Free hardware, advocate for civil liberties and net neutrality, critical of corporate influence in politics, engaged in discussions about economic inequality and wealth concentration, frequent user of Linux and programming languages like Lisp and Scala, active in online tech communities, particularly Hacker News and Reddit, values intellectual integrity and empirical evidence, critical of traditional education systems, interested in data science and machine learning, supports organizations like EFF and Politifact.
